[CORRECTION] Morga did confirm the refugees are resting somewhere in the house, and she is friendly and wants this settled; nothing on record shows her opposing you. She never actually answered the part about sitting near them, which is why a roll was framed at all. But the failure it showed, 'Morga refuses you outright and keeps you away', did not fit her stance. The offer is being withdrawn and framed again with that context; nothing has been spent.

results.screen:
Morga looks at you a long moment over the rim of the pot, then gives a short nod, the way a woman nods once she has already made up her mind. "Aye, that's fair enough, my duck. Sit near them and listen all you like. They've been through enough without a stranger at their elbow, so keep your voice low." She wipes her scarred hand on her apron and turns back to the stove, where the kettle has begun its rattle. Roswen goes on rocking on his crutch and does not look your way. Morga's eyes come back to you once more, as though she is waiting to see what you will do next.
